prompt:
Create ONE large boss monster sprite for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG battle (a single figure).

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: the light-grey box shows where the boss stands and how big it is (fill the box), the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the boss faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, crisp cel shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero.

Render as true pixel art: the boss about 140-168 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, rich detail and 3-4 tones per colour like a premium modern pixel-art boss.

Boss: the Death Eye, a colossal undead eyeball hovering in the air, seen from the front, bound in strips of torn grey grave cloth wrapped around it, a crown of yellowed bones and small skulls set on top, one huge sickly yellow iris with a black slit pupil and bloodshot veins, the iris turned slightly toward the heroes on the right, ghostly pale-violet tendrils trailing below it, their tips well above the bottom of the grey box; nothing touches the ground; the whole figure, crown included, well below the top of the grey box; palette of grave grey, bone yellow, sickly yellow, blood red and pale violet. FACE: the huge yellow iris and slit pupil are the face; no mouth, no other eyes.

Pose: idle, a ready battle stance, facing right.

BODY: hovering above the ground, nothing touches the ground, no shadow, no water.

Only the boss: no other characters, no scenery, no floor tiles, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no shadows, no borders, no panels.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a mouth, teeth, eyestalks, a second eye, arms, legs.
